question: What Is ASME PTC 19.3 TW-2016 for Thermowell Design?
body_html:
ASME PTC 19.3 TW-2016 is the American Society of Mechanical Engineers standard for the mechanical design of thermowells. It checks whether a thermowell can withstand fluid velocity, vibration, resonance and mechanical stress, not just pressure and temperature.

The key check is the frequency ratio of wake (Strouhal) frequency to the thermowell natural frequency. If the two get close, resonance causes high vibration and failure, so the ratio must stay within the limits the standard sets.
